meta.title: The Creator's Loop — A Movie Is a Song Video to Polish
meta.subtitle: Your view: the 80% is cheap, the 20% is the product — a revision is a save, and drift is loud

cards.title: The economics you named
items: The storyboard deck already cost a lot of tokens
Clients pay for video revisions, not deck updates
Unpaid deck changes accumulate until storyboard and video drift
Reconciling drift later is the time sink

cards.title: The treasure
items: The 80% is precondition; the 20% is the product
Subjects load with their exact tracks; verses load their kinetic text
A save command is an edit — no tool-hopping, no re-declaring concepts
The creative act never leaves your hand

cards.title: Node detail (moved from the boxes)
items: Pinpoint the Moment: the frame that needs it
Load Tracks or a Verse: exact tracks · only the needed options
Nudge → See It Again: move small details · clean artifacts · the 20%
Magic Studio: wrapper — project book · skills · panels
Save = the Edit: lands in the composition
Storyboard Deck: already paid for in tokens
Drift Check: deck vs video — loudly, never silent rot

production.label: Upload audio
production.pipeline: Link the complete recording and the artist’s original lyric sheet. The current audio intake also initializes the HyperFrames project.
production.verify: Play the linked recording and open the artist’s document.

production.label: Verify transcription against the artist’s lyrics
production.command:
magic-cli audio analyze analyze_beats=true
magic-cli song lyrics
magic-cli words align
production.pipeline: Transcribe the full recording with beats. Keep line numbers for fingerplays and sung verse/chorus order for songs. Use the artist’s wording for discrepancies.
production.verify: Listen through the recording against the artist’s sheet. Resolve transcription warnings, missing lines and timing problems before continuing.

production.label: Complete the storyboard
production.command:
magic-cli ui click id=tab-storyboard
magic-cli ui click id=sb-open-deck
production.pipeline: Open the project’s existing deck in DeckCraft. Fill the section cues, shots, staging, continuity and links to editable artwork. The open action requires a saved deck.
production.verify: Reopen the saved deck. Check every section and follow its asset links.

production.label: Generate the full rough video
production.command:
magic-cli video assemble export=false
magic-cli video open
production.pipeline: Build a full-length FilmCraft cut from the storyboard and recording. Place the transitions in FilmCraft; broad movement is enough for this pass.
production.verify: Play from the opening to the end. Check picture coverage, section changes and transitions against the song.

production.label: Create animated text
production.command:
magic-cli words read
magic-cli words letter
production.pipeline: Design the lettering in Lyrics, attach it to the verified word timings and render the lettering track.
production.verify: Watch a sung phrase and its repeat. Confirm that the correct words appear, are readable and clear on cue.

production.label: Create motion graphics for verbs and actions
production.command:
magic-cli words save --help
magic-cli words compose animation_id=<phrase>
production.pipeline: Choose the learning verb in each phrase. Use a repeatable graphic cue, such as a curved arrow for ‘turn’, and time it to the word.
production.verify: Play the cue with the recording. A viewer should be able to identify and imitate the action.

production.label: Create the character animation
production.command:
magic-cli animation review
magic-cli animation prepare-motion character=<id> clip=<clip> option=baseline
production.pipeline: 1. Reuse an animated model and clip. 2. If needed, skin a suitable base body type. 3. Generate from a 2D reference only when neither exists. The commands shown review and prepare existing clips; skinning and generation require an asset-authoring step.
production.verify: Watch each chosen motion all the way through on its character. Check silhouette, hands, contacts and collisions.

production.label: Save the project and update FilmCraft
production.command:
magic-cli project save
magic-cli video timeline
production.pipeline: Save the .magic project and bring revised shots and lettering into the designated .fcproj. Today project.save saves Magic only. Update and save the existing cut in FilmCraft; rebuilding a hand-edited timeline needs a deliberate decision.
production.verify: Reopen the designated FilmCraft project and confirm the revised picture, lettering and audio tracks are there.

production.label: Review the cut or return to editing
production.pipeline: Play the whole cut with sound. Return to the relevant storyboard, lettering, motion or timeline step for corrections, then save and preview again.
production.verify: Check timing, legibility, actions and continuity. Export only when the cut is approved.

production.label: Export for final review
production.pipeline: Render the approved FilmCraft timeline to the delivery file.
production.verify: Open the exported file outside Studio and review it from beginning to end with sound.
